facts.fact: The World Bank's World Development Indicators list 2013 as the year of Mauritania's latest population census.

The World Bank's World Development Indicators list the Enquete Demographique et de Sante de la Mauritanie 2019-2021 as Mauritania's latest demographic, education or health household survey, year 2021.
facts.system: Enquete Demographique et de Sante de la Mauritanie 2019-2021

facts.fact: The World Bank's World Development Indicators give an integrated household survey of 2014 as the source of Mauritania's most recent income and expenditure data.
